One directory per publisher, each with the layout of a file on the IATI Bulk Data Service, cut to whole `iati-activity` elements: all three activities of GEF Bahrain (`gef-bh.xml`); two each from GEF Lebanon and Mexico (the activity with a stray `<` in its text, which makes the file ill-formed, plus one well-formed activity); four GCF and three CAF activities with both commitments and disbursements; and two EIB activities (one in EUR, one that defaults to EUR but states its transactions in USD). Activity identifiers, element structure, codes, dates and currencies are real. Titles, descriptions, organisation and place names, contacts, links, coordinates and every amount are invented. Every GEF activity carries the note that its disbursement data is cumulative; Bahrain `XI-BRIDGE-6385676864-9734` reports cumulative figures of 0 and 142,500 in 2020, 0 in 2022 and 2023, and 171,000 in 2024.
